title: The Ultimate Vacation Hair Kit: What to Pack by Hair Type
summary: Key Takeaways Travel can change your hair. Airplane cabins, humidity, hard water, chlorine, and salt water can leave hair dry, frizzy, or harder to manage. Hydration is key. A hair mask and leave-in conditioner help replenish moisture and protect hair during travel. Choose products for your hair type. Straight, wavy, curly, and coily hair each have different travel care needs. Hotel water matters. Hard water minerals can cause buildup, making hair feel dull, dry, and less manageable. Pack travel-sized essentials. Keeping your routine with travel-friendly bottles helps maintain healthy hair wherever you go.
